create.title: Create a new file
create.hint: Enter a file name (with extension). You will choose where to save it.
create.unsupportedKind: AI generation isn't available for this file type yet. It will be created empty.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the content to generate. e.g. A project README with setup steps and a feature list.
create.referencesHint: Attach files for the agent to draw on (their text is read as context).

ideMenu.pickFile: Select a file from the tree to start editing

empty.noRecent: No recent files yet. Open a file to get started.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.startHint: Start a chat to ask about or edit “{{file}}”. The assistant can edit the open document directly with formatting-preserving tools.
assistant.noAgents: No agents available. Add a CLI agent or an assistant in Settings.

collab.title: Real-time collaboration
collab.lanNote: This shares the document over your local network (LAN). Anyone on the same network with the code and password can edit. Use a strong password.
collab.shareHint: Share the join code and password with people on the same network.
collab.serverNeeded: A Document Server is required to publish. Start Docker or set a Document Server URL.
collab.unreachable: Could not reach the host. Check the address and that you are on the same network.
collab.onlineHint: Let people on other networks join. The first time, the tunnel tool installs automatically (may take a minute).
collab.onlineWarn: This exposes the document to the public Internet for the session. Use a strong password — anyone with the link and password can edit.
collab.weakPassword: For Internet sharing, use a strong password (6+ chars, not 123456).
